newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Citra Marga earnings seen attractive.
newsitem.headline: Citra Marga earnings seen attractive.

text.p: ING Barings said in a research report that earnings growth of toll road operator PT Citra Marga Nusaphala Persada was attractive, with a compound annual growth rate of 22 percent from 1996 to 2000.
Barings forecast Citra Marga profit would hit 149.7 billion rupiah in 1997 and 178.8 billion rupiah in 1998.
Citra Marga said on Monday its 1996 net profit was 123.6 billion rupiah, compared with 94 billion rupiah in 1995, and forecast 1997 profit of 145 billion rupiah.
It said a positive factor was that it had retired about 75 percent of its 275 billion rupiah revenue-sharing bonds with cheaper dollar-denominated floating rate notes.
Barings said this should reduce its funding costs to 11 percent from around 20 percent annually from 1996.
But it said political risk was likely to be inherent for a company that was at the centre of the political arena.
Citra Marga is partly owned by President Suharto's eldest daughter Siti Hardiyanti Rukmana.
